---
title: "**Talk title**"
subtitle: ".font130[A short subtitle goes here]"
author: ".author-card[]"
date: ".meta-info[Venue · Date · Session info]"
notes: |
  <ul>
  <li>One-line speaker note for the title slide.
  </ul>
output:
  xaringan::moon_reader:
    chakra: ./libs/remark-latest.min.js
    self_contained: false
    css: [default, ./libs/theme.css, ./libs/theme-fonts.css, ./libs/tachyons-min.css, ./custom.css]
    nature:
      ratio: '16:9'
      highlightStyle: github
      highlightLines: true
      countIncrementalSlides: false
      titleSlideClass: [top, left]
      slideNumberFormat: "%current%"
template: ./libs/default.html
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r setup-citations, include=FALSE}
source("./libs/cite-helper.R")
mtg_init_citations("references.bib")
```



<!-- ##################################################### Section heading -->
---
layout: false
class: clear
background-image: url(./img/your-background.png)
background-size: 120%
background-position: 70% 30%
count: true
# A first content slide
.citations[Source: `r cite("citekey_one")`]
???
- Speaker note: open with the framing point.



<!-- ##################################################### Outlook -->
---
layout: false
class: outlook-slide
count: true
# Research question

.bg-dr-white[
  .font-dark.opac-80.font250[A single-line question, takeaway, or framing.]
]
???
- Speaker note for the outlook slide.



<!-- ##################################################### Closing slide -->
---
layout: false
class: closing-slide closing-slide-final
count: false
# Thank you

.font120.font-dark.opac-80[
**Your Name**<br>
[your.email@example.org](mailto:your.email@example.org)<br>
Your Institution
]

???
- Thank you — I welcome questions.



<!-- ##################################################### References -->
```{r refs-slide, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if (has_citations()) {
  cat("---\n")
  cat("layout: false\n")
  cat("class: refs-slide\n")
  cat("count: false\n")
  cat("# References\n\n")
  cat('<div id="refs">\n')
  cat(bibliography())
  cat("\n</div>\n")
}
```
